verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own features page says its AI handles "sending bulk collection reminders" and that workflows can be triggered to notify, which partly covers payment reminders. Nothing in the pack documents recurring invoices, and nothing confirms reminders fire automatically for overdue customers. missing for 10: any evidence of recurring invoice profiles/schedules, explicit automatic overdue-payment reminder configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: Whether it's sending bulk collection reminders, categorizing bank statements, or building workflow Blueprints, AI in Zoho Books turns financial data into the next step automatically
Trigger workflow: Easily create and trigger unique business workflows to notify, update, or validate information
